capabilities: Draw a seeded hex map with terrain, rivers, roads and towns
Key every hex with a site, resource or rumour
Move a party hex by hex with weather, encounters and getting lost
Track rations, foraging and buying food
Write hex notes and save the map as a PNG
disambiguation: Not a hex editor or a binary tool; it generates hex-crawl maps for tabletop roleplaying games.
extras: Free plugin; optional paid add-ons are Mapsmith Pro ($6 once) and DM Screen ($12 once, free one-hour trial without a key). A browser demo runs the same plugin code.
problem: Tabletop groups running hex-crawl campaigns have no way to generate and keep a persistent, keyed region map inside their campaign notes.

relations.evidence: with the free Mapsmith plugin installed, the town's streets or the ruin's dungeon are drawn right there
With DM Screen installed, the map gets a Show the party's map to players button.

summary: Hex-crawl map generator that draws a seeded hex region in a note, keys every hex, and tracks a party's day-by-day travel.
